verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਤ੍ਰਿਬਿਧੀ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਕਤ੍ਰ ਸੈ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਭਏ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aatam tirabidhee jatr katr sai ikatr bhe gurmat sat nihachal man maane hai ||

en.bdb: With the acquisition of True Guru's consecration and His wisdom, the mind wandering in three traits of maya becomes stable and then it feels reassured in the words of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਗ ਜਗ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਰ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jagajeevan jag jag jagajeevan mai pooran braham giaan dhiaan ur aane hai ||

en.bdb: One who has received the elixir-like Name of the Lord, practiced it, sees the Lord and the world intermingled. That Sikh of the Guru imbibes the knowledge in his heart since it has been blessed by the complete God-like True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖਮ ਸਥੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਗੋਰਸ ਗੋਬੰਸ ਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਹਿਚਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sookham sathool mool ek hee anek mek goras goba(n)s gat prem pahichaane hai ||

en.bdb: The loving hue of Lord's name, the Sikh of the Guru recognises the presence of the Lord in gross and imperceptible species just as well species of cows yield same type of milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਰਨ ਮੈੈ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੈ ਚਿਤੇਰੋ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਜਨਕ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੭॥
verses.translit_en: kaaran maiai kaaran karan chitr mai chitero ja(n)tr dhun ja(n)tree jan kai janak jaane hai ||227||

en.bdb: He realises that the Lord is permeated in His creation as is a painter in his painting, a tune in the musical instrument and qualities of father in his son. (227)
